title: fix: preserve Gemini tool-call thought signatures
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Chat request validation now preserves Gemini thought signatures on assistant tool calls, so a signed tool call can be sent back with its result. A regression test covers that exchange; the existing schema and routing are otherwise unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and watches a signed tool-call note travel from a lime-green (#ecf874) terminal to a little CRT robot carrying the result, with code-plants growing beside them. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized or elongated, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic, with a warm cream and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
